description: Free. For sellers: claim every x402 endpoint paid to your wallet with one signature, on every host, so your name, website, contact and docs show next to them (plus a 10-day Seller Watch trial). Use when: you operate x402 endpoints. Not for: buyers or third parties; only the payTo wallet can sign. Flow: call with wallet and profile to get message_to_sign and issued_at; sign with that wallet; call again with issued_at and signature. action=remove withdraws a claim (reversible by claiming again). Claims never change scores.

action.description: claim (default) or remove to withdraw an existing claim

contact.description: How buyers can reach you, e.g. hello@example.com or @handle on X

docs.description: Your API documentation, as a full https URL

issued_at.description: The issued_at timestamp returned by the first call; send it back unchanged with the signature

name.description: Seller name to show on your endpoints, up to 80 characters, e.g. Acme Data

signature.description: Signature of message_to_sign by the wallet: EIP-191 personal_sign (0x hex) on Base, ed25519 (base58) on Solana; omit on the first call

wallet.description: The payTo wallet your endpoints are paid to: 0x + 40 hex characters on Base, or a base58 address on Solana

website.description: Your website, as a full https URL

name: settled_claim

attestation.description: EIP-191 signature over the answer; verify it with settled_verify or any EVM library

claimed.description: true once the claim is recorded

covers.description: The endpoints and hosts the claim covers

error.description: signature_required on the first call (sign message_to_sign and call again), or why the claim was refused

issued_at.description: Timestamp to send back with the signature

message_to_sign.description: The exact message to sign with the wallet

profile.description: The published profile: name, website, contact, docs

removed.description: true once a claim is withdrawn

would_cover.description: The endpoints and hosts the claim would cover

title: Claim your endpoints (sellers)
